answer: Each agent identity must hold a vault key issued only after a one-time liveness check at a licensed kiosk: the operator shows ID, the kiosk records a live face match, and it signs a credential tied to one device key. Peers reject keys without a fresh signature, and duplicate faces revoke the credential. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 visits at $18 and 20 minutes each, about $18,000 and 333 hours before fake ID costs, even at a busy summit venue. Like an island ferry checking one ticket per passenger, the gate stays cheap for one honest agent and punishing for a thousand fakes.
